spec.description:
Ecowool ClimaWrap (ClimaWrap CW / ClimaWrap BMX800) is a
durable, triple-layer Class 4 vapour-permeable building wrap engineered to
provide weather defense and moisture control in external walls. Constructed with
two spunbonded non-woven outer layers protecting a microporous vapour-permeable
inner membrane core, it acts as a water and air barrier while allowing internal
water vapour to escape. Compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1:2017 and the National
Construction Code across climate zones 2 to 8, it reduces condensation risks
behind brick veneer, fibre cement, timber, and metal claddings.
features:
Triple-layer spunbond non-woven construction for high tensile and tear
strength

Class 4 Vapour Permeable membrane specially designed to minimise
condensation risk

Functions as a water barrier protecting the building frame
from external weather penetration

Effective air barrier reducing air leakage
and enhancing thermal efficiency

Flammability Index Low (<5) tested to
AS 1530.2-1993

Suitable for a wide range of climatic conditions across
Australia (Zones 2 to 8)

Puncture and tear resistant during construction on
site

Protects on both faces by non-woven structures against corrosive
environments

spec.fire:
Flammability Index Low (< 5)
tested in accordance with AS 1530.2-1993; Suitable for external walls in
bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 under AS 3959
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2, AS 1530.2-1993, NCC 2019 / NCC 2022 Volume 1
and 2 condensation management
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP, non-hazardous, 100%
recyclable polyolefin polymer fabrics, low VOC
install:
Install
horizontally on external timber or steel studs starting from the bottom plate

Fasten mechanically to framing members at maximum 300mm centres using
broad-head nails or staples

Ensure upper layers overlap lower layers by at
least 150mm to shed water outward

Vertical joints must overlap by at
least 150mm over a stud

Seal all overlaps and penetrations with EcoSeal 201
Cloth Tape for airtight weather resistance

Provide adequate drainage cavity
between ClimaWrap and exterior cladding (especially non-absorbent claddings like
steel)

Seal neatly around window and door openings prior to installing
joinery
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall construction requires a
Class 4 breathable vapour-permeable membrane

Calculate roll quantities based on wall area allowing 150mm
overlaps

Check climate zone suitability (certified for climate zones 2
to 8)
Order complementary EcoSeal 201 Cloth Tape for joint sealing
limitations:
Claddings must
provide a drained cavity; provision must be given for drainage of trapped
moisture behind steel cladding

Must not be left exposed to direct sunlight
beyond recommended UV exposure limits

use_cases:
Vapour-permeable
weather barrier behind residential and commercial brick veneer walls

Moisture
protection behind fibre-cement and timber cladding in climate zones 2 to 8
Air and water barrier house wrap on timber and light-gauge steel framing
retrieval.rag_summary:
Ecowool Wrap (ClimaWrap CW /
BMX800) is a triple-layer, Class 4 vapour-permeable building wrap manufactured
by PGF Insulation. Engineered with two non-woven spunbond outer layers
protecting an inner microporous breathable membrane, it stops liquid water and
draft infiltration while allowing water vapour to diffuse outward (3.967 µg/N·s
permeance). Tested to AS/NZS 4200.1:2017 with a low Flammability Index (<5,
BAL-40 compliant), it prevents condensation and timber rot behind residential
and commercial wall claddings across climate zones 2 through 8.
